resourceName: Henan Tongbai and Zhenping Afforestation Project
description:
Henan Tongbai and Zhenping Afforestation Project (hereafter referred as “the project”) is located in Tongbai county and Zhenping county, Nanyang City, Henan Province, China. The project is to establish forest on the barren land to generate GHG emission reductions and contribute to local sustainable development. The project is 22,292.4 ha of forest was established by direct planted on barren lands in Tongbai county and Zhenping county, Nanyang City, Henan Province, China. 

The project activity aims to:  Sequester carbon dioxide and mitigating climate change; Enhance biodiversity conservation by increasing the connectivity of forests; - Improve the quality and quantity of the vegetation; Improve soil and water conservation and contribute to sustainable development; Generate income and job opportunities for local communities. 

There is no natural renewal and reforestation and all sites were barren hills at least 10 years prior to the implementation of the project. The main objective specie are Pinus massoniana, Pinus elliottii, Paulownia, Populus, Acer mono Maxim, Broad-leaved tree and Oak which are native species according to the baseline survey. With the implementation of the project activity, total GHG emission reductions or removals are about 22,625,866 tCO2e in 60 years the average annual emission reduction is 377,097 tCO2e and total GHG emission reductions or removals with buffer deduction is about 20,363,279 tCO2e in 60 years, the average annual GHG emission reductions or removals with buffer deduction is 339,387 tCO2e.
